source.retrieval: Printed to PDF in a browser by the repository owner on 2026-10-16; the page blocks automated fetches.

findings.electrolytics: All seven XRL part numbers are confirmed. The two 100uF Mouser numbers are transposed relative to their descriptions; the descriptions, references, parts page, kit photographs and circuit agree, so C48/C49/C102 are 10 V (5 x 11 mm) and C7/C8 are 25 V (6.3 x 11 mm). Revision-21 models unchanged.
findings.resistors: 208 of the 209 listed resistors match the revision-22 bands, including R106 at 24K 1%. R157, R158 and R160 are unlisted but are 10K (parts page and PCB) and fill the 10K row quantity. R16 is 100 ohm on this page and on the PCB; the parts page gives 100 ohm for older kits and 150 ohm for newer kits, and revision 22 shows the newer 150 ohm.
findings.sockets_and_ics: Socket, EEPROM, 4N37 and FT232BM rows agree with revisions 23 and 24. The page lists IC16-IC18 as 74AC165 (the parts page allows 74AC165 or 74HC165; the revision-24 marking shows 74HC165N) and the microcontroller as Atmega162-40PI (the photographed part reads ATMEGA162 16PI).

corrections_to_earlier_records: Revision 22 recorded R16 as a PCB/parts-page value difference; the parts page actually lists R16 as 100 ohm in older kits and 150 ohm in newer kits.
